appliedUpdates.description: Updated hybrid-decode-validation.md 'Known Limitations' section to remove outdated statement that TQ hybrid Triton kernels 'may not be HIP graph compatible'. The graph-mode-compatibility-test feature confirmed FULL_DECODE_ONLY graph capture works (35 graphs captured). Also corrected the Configuration section which incorrectly stated --enforce-eager is required.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add guidance: When validating 'stats show X happening', integration tests must assert that X is non-zero at the implementation level (e.g., via stats counters in test assertions), not just that the server responded successfully. VAL-HYB-003 passed solely because requests worked, not because compressed KV reads were confirmed.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: hybrid-decode-implementation VAL-HYB-003: test_hyb_003_compressed_kv_reads() conditionally passes if 'requests working in hybrid mode', which is always true when the server is running. This provides no evidence that the hybrid decode path was actually invoked.

rejectedObservations.observation: Add library doc note about graph compatibility detection relying on log string matching
rejectedObservations.reason: This is an implementation detail of the test script, not actionable library knowledge. Already captured in the review report.

rejectedObservations.observation: Add library doc note that Triton kernels in decode path need verification
rejectedObservations.reason: The tq-hybrid-graph-compatibility.md already provides a clear explanation of why graph capture works (PyTorch matmuls in decode path). Adding further uncertainty would be unhelpful without concrete evidence of a problem.
